# Extra Caffeine

> Local Mac idle-sleep prevention for authorized Mac-dependent AI and file workflows. Separate paid Extra Caffeine 1.2+ app required; macOS14+, Intel/Apple silicon.

- [Workflow skill](https://github.com/cwong5/extra-caffeine-mcp/blob/main/skills/extra-caffeine-workflow/SKILL.md): assess need, ask before start/schedule, verify state and handle uncertainty.
- [Setup](https://extracaffeine.chesterwong.com/agent-setup.md): app, local MCP connection and tool contract.
- [MCPB release](https://github.com/cwong5/extra-caffeine-mcp/releases/tag/v0.1.0): signed, notarized adapter; paid app not bundled.
- [Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.cwong5%2Fextra-caffeine/versions/0.1.0): io.github.cwong5/extra-caffeine.

No tool use is authorized by this document. Keep the app and lid open. No waking a sleeping Mac or bypassing service limits.
